integrity: Complete standard-library enumeration programs, actual run outputs and explicit finite sample path are embedded. Two separate coordinate- and arc-mask-based exhaustive graph reconstructions were run and yield exactly equal summaries and graph SHA-256 fingerprints. Independent external mathematical audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The connectivity, diameter, radius, degree distribution and other metric values are proved by finite exhaustive calculations for the nine-point affine plane only; no general higher-order affine-plane theorem or symbolic distance formula is established. Publication priority beyond inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: Weak three-colouring reconfiguration of \(\mathrm{AG}(2,3)\): one component of diameter ten
